snippets.snippet: City of Druid Hills Summary of Ordinances P a g e | 2 Revised: 2019 In 2016 the City Commissioners approved an amendment to this Ordinance implementing a Tree Rebate program to encourage residents to plant trees. A $50.00 per tree rebate is available to residents who meet the program criteria. Ordinance 10 -This ordinance requires all residents to submit detailed plans and specifications for the construction of any buildings, additions to buildings, porches, swimming pools, additional out-buildings or additional paving to the City of Druid Hills' Review Committee prior to the start of construction. Approval by this Committee is required before Metro Louisville will issue a building permit. Note: This ordinance does not supersede any Metro Louisville laws or regulations.
